relationships.history: Roommates and the two halves of Heritage Coffee's day. Imani draws; Sol sings; the regulars think they're sisters.
Kai's beats are better when Sol is in the room. Sol tells him so, which doesn't help.
Leila writes in the corner every evening and tips like a journalist: badly, but always.
Oat latte, extra hot, 8:10 sharp. Sol has it ready at 8:09.

memories.info: First open mic at the Copper Tap: three songs, one standing ovation from Bernie.

profile.tagline: Runs the morning rush. Sings the night down.

appearance.hair: a copper curly afro under a deep teal corduroy bucket hat
appearance.style: cream shirt with a small red-and-teal print, sleeves rolled, brown corduroy waistcoat, wide brown corduroy trousers, brown leather loafers

outfits.everyday: cream shirt with a small red-and-teal print, sleeves rolled, brown corduroy waistcoat, wide brown corduroy trousers, brown leather loafers, deep teal corduroy bucket hat
outfits.work: cream printed shirt with the sleeves rolled, a charcoal canvas barista apron, wide brown corduroy trousers, brown leather loafers
outfits.evening: deep teal velvet blazer over a white ribbed tank, wide brown corduroy trousers, brown leather loafers, the teal bucket hat, silver rings

appearance.silhouette: a bucket hat over a halo of copper curls, wide cords

profile.family_background: Grew up in the Bronx between their abuela's kitchen and their father's church choir. Left New York after a band, a lease and a relationship ended in the same month.
profile.education: High school diploma; two semesters of music school
goals: Play a full set at ÉCLAT
Make shift lead mean something: a raise for Imani
ambitions: An album recorded at Low End Studios
profile.social_preferences: Everyone at the counter, nobody too close for long.

secrets.truth: The song that got their old band signed was Sol's. The band kept it, and the credit.

weekdays.activity: Home, a nap, then the piano

thursday.activity: Open mic at The Copper Tap

social_media.bio: shift lead @ heritage. open mic thursdays. they/them.

life_history: Sang in their father's choir until they were sixteen.
Played keys in a Bronx band that got signed without them.
Shift lead at Heritage Coffee within a month of arriving.
